sections.label: Tagline
sections.content: Leverages Brunswick Corporation's comprehensive ACES (Autonomy/Assistance, Connectivity, Electrification, Shared Access) innovation strategy, positioning itself at the forefront of marine technology and experience transformation. Benefits from being part of a global marine recreation leader.

sections.label: Description
sections.content: Mercury Marine Japan is the Japanese regional entity for Mercury Marine, a leading global manufacturer of marine engines, parts, and accessories. As a brand of Brunswick Corporation, it benefits from the parent company's focus on innovation in electrification, connectivity, autonomy, and shared access models for the marine industry, aiming to provide advanced and reliable propulsion solutions for boaters in Japan and globally.

sections.label: Core capabilities
sections.content:
Marine propulsion systems (outboard
sterndrive
diesel)
electric propulsion systems
marine parts and accessories.

sections.label: Pricing
sections.content: Product sales (e.g., engines, parts), likely through authorized dealers and distributors.

sections.label: Target industry
sections.content: Marine consumers, boat manufacturers, and the broader marine recreation industry, globally (with an inferred focus on Japan for Mercury Marine Japan).
